2:1.text: [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings.]

2:2.text: , whereof there is no doubt, a guidance to those who are Al-Muttaqûn

[the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism who fear Allâh much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden) and love Allâh much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)]

2:3.text: and spend out of what We have provided for them
and spend out of what We have provided for them [i.e. give Zakât
, spend on themselves, their parents, their children, their wives, etc., and also give charity to the poor and also in Allâh’s Cause - Jihâd].

2:4.text: and in that which was sent down before you
and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter.
(Resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell)

2:5.text: guidance from their Lord, and they are the successful.
